title: Hearing on e-bike, e-scooter and delivery worker safety rules
summary: The Council's Transportation, Consumer and Worker Protection, and Public Safety committees held a joint hearing on regulating micromobility devices such as e-bikes, e-scooters and mopeds. Lawmakers reviewed over 20 bills covering topics like banning the fastest e-bikes, licensing delivery apps, requiring liability insurance and crash reporting, moped registration checks, and safety technology for bike-share systems. Officials from the Department of Transportation, Department of Consumer and Worker Protection and NYPD were invited to testify alongside safety advocates and delivery workers.
